html: † חַצֲצֹן תָּמָר n.pr.loc. (ח׳ of the palm);—abode of Amorites Gn 14:7, 𝔊 Ασασαν Θαμαρ; חַצֲצוֹן תָּמָר הִיא עֵין גֶּ֑דִי 2 Ch 20:2 base of operations for אֲרַם (read אֱדוֹם) ag. Judah (vid. JosAnt.. ix, 1, 2); it was on W. side of Dead Sea (v. עֵין גֶּ֫דִי); see RobBR i, 500–509 BdPal. 143 GASmGeogr. 269 ff.; Wady Ḥuṣāṣā (= חצצן?) lies NW. from Engedi GASml.c. cf. RobBR i, 506 BdPal 14 (map); GASm suggests also possibility of finding here תָּמָר 1 K 9:18 Kt (= תַּדְמֹר Qr and 2 Ch 8:4), Ez 47:19; 48:28 (v. תָּמָר n.pr.loc.)
